name: comp-171
title: Interactive Star Rating
blurb: Five stars that fill on click, with hover scale effect.
description: Interactive star rating selector with hover preview and scale animation. Built on shadcn's RadioGroup with state.
use_when: Collecting star ratings from users with visual feedback on hover and selection.
avoid_when: When you need half-star ratings or a numeric input field instead.
a11y: Built on accessible RadioGroup with hidden radio inputs and sr-only labels for each star value.
